See Annual Gold details ↗

Court booking: Visitors pay $100/hour peak or $50/hour off-peak. Gold members receive 50% off their own per-player share. Example: when a $100 peak court is split among four players, a Gold member pays $12.50 and a visitor pays $25. Annual Gold 4-pay option: $700 today, then $700/month for three more months ($2,800 total).

Peak hours: Weekdays 5:00 PM–9:30 PM and weekends all day. Overnight pricing: Weekdays 12:00 AM–5:00 AM are charged at the peak rate due to additional overnight operating costs. Gold free open play: Max 4 outstanding bookings at one time—complete or cancel one before adding another. Other: $20 no-show penalty · Quarterly billed every 3 months.

Have Questions ? Email us at BK@indoorpickleballx.com or call us at +1 (929)593-4432 .

Strategically Located

Brooklyn's Best Address for Pickleball

Located at 49 Ash St, Indoor Pickleball X is Brooklyn’s dedicated indoor pickleball club, minutes from the Pulaski Bridge, Williamsburg, and Manhattan. With 13 courts, a gym, showers, and workspaces, it’s built for playing, working, and connecting—all under one roof.

49 Ash St, Brooklyn

🌉 Near Pulaski Bridge

🚇 Easy from Manhattan

🏘️ Near Williamsburg

Path 01 — New to Pickleball

Beginner 101 lessons

Never held a paddle? No problem. Our certified coaches will have you rallying, scoring, and loving the game in your very first session. We provide everything — paddles, balls, and a whole lot of encouragement.

  • Equipment provided — paddles, balls, everything
  • Small groups of 4–6 players max
  • Certified USAPA-trained coaches
  • All ages and fitness levels welcome
  • First session free for new members

Path 02 — Frequent Player

ways to Play

From casual drop-ins to competitive leagues — find the format that fits your game and your schedule.

 

Drop In & Play

No reservation needed for open play. Show up, stack your paddle, and get on the court. Available all day, every day for members.

 
BOOK NOW

Reserve Your Court

Book a private court for your group. Perfect for practice sessions, casual play with friends, or small group training.

 
BOOK NOW

Compete in a League

Join a structured season of competitive play. Skill-matched brackets, weekly matches, and end-of-season championships.

 
BOOK NOW

Sharpen Your Game

Level-specific clinics led by certified coaches. From dinking and third-shot drops to advanced strategy and tournament prep.

 
BOOK NOW

Fun Events

More than just a game—it’s a celebration. Join us for high-energy events where the dinks are secondary to the smiles. Whether it’s a glow-in-the-dark night or a weekend social, we guarantee more laughs per hour than anywhere else in NYC.

 
BOOK NOW

2 Easy Ways to Book

Get on the court in minutes — pick the method that works best for you

01 Download the App

For the fastest experience, download the Indoor Pickleball X app. Check in on arrival, manage your bookings, and get push notifications for open play availability — all from your phone.

Google Play Apple Store
02 Book Online

Head to our public booking page to browse available courts, open play sessions, and clinics. Select your date, time, and number of players — then confirm your spot in seconds.

 Kareen Nato 
 
 
 
 Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. 
IPX features 9 indoor, climate-controlled courts and is OPEN 24/7! Equipped with high resolution cameras that can record your games! It offers open play, leagues, clinics, and events (birthday parties, team building, etc).
It is the home of the Aces (East Bay Aces)! The owner goes around to play too, a kind gesture to socialize. They have friendly staff that loves to play pickleball! They offer coaching for beginners and also for players who want to elevate their games. These coaches are DUPR rated and won several medals on both local and PPA tourneys.
They are already planning tournaments, open play for the coming holidays, NYE and valentines! So grab your paddles and follow their page for more info😁

 HappyDinker 
 
 
 
 Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. 
Indoor Pickleball X in Concord is such a solid spot, especially as the weather gets colder. They’ve got 10+ courts, clean restrooms, professional nets, and a mini pro shop for anything you might need. One thing I really appreciate is the court lines — no skidding at all, which makes a huge difference when you’re moving fast.

But the real highlight here is the community. Super fun, welcoming, and collaborative staff and members that make it easy to jump in and enjoy the games. Great energy all around and feels well-run.

Highly recommend checking it out if you’re looking for a legit indoor place to play and meet good people 🙌🎾
